title: guard: pr-rla record blocked
caption: The plugin's guard hook, run directly on the command an assistant tries: exit 2, the verdict stays with the person.
alt: Terminal output: the guard blocks pr-rla record with exit code 2

commands.command: echo '{"hook_event_name":"PreToolUse","cwd":"/x","tool_name":"Bash","tool_input":{"command":"pr-rla record 1 pass --reviewer a --note b"}}' | node integrations/claude-code/hooks/guard.mjs
commands.output:
pr-rla guard blocked this: pr-rla record writes a verdict, and a verdict is the reviewer's: they run "pr-rla record …" themselves (a person's own command, in their own terminal), or apply the label in the tracker.
(pr-rla's guard keeps the verdict with the person reviewing: see docs/assistants/guard.md in pr-rla.)
